title: Handoff and Fallback - Solo Notes for Release Readiness
content:
Purpose: quick owner-facing prep for the weekly release-train check (one-person view). I’m using this as my CEO-of-last-mile checklist before I step into the meeting and to capture follow-ups immediately after.

Meeting time: Weekly release readiness sync (Thu 09:30 PST). I join at 09:20 for last-minute sync with infra.
Attendees I care about: Infra on call (Kai), SRE (Aria), Product PM (Victor), Release Manager (Elena), QA lead (Sam), Console owner (Rohit).

AGENDA (my shorthand):
- Quick health check (infra, DB migrations, feature flags) - 3m
- Go/no-go decision for the next window - 5m
- Known risks + mitigations (owner review) - 7m
- Rollback plan & validation gates - 5m
- Post-deployment smoke checklist and monitoring targets - 5m
- Actions and owners - 5m

PRE-MEETING CHECKS (things I must confirm before the call):
- [ ] DB migration dry-run status: migration-2026-03-10 completed in staging without locks (Sam) - confirmed 03/11
- [ ] Canary config ready in prod: console route pinned to canary cluster (Rohit) - needs final flag flip
- [ ] Dedicated capacity reservation: Dedicated pool has 2 spare nodes for surge (Kai) - confirmed
- [ ] Backup snapshot time: nightly snapshot ok, but take one pre-deploy (ops-runbook step)
- [ ] Key rotation windows: none scheduled within deploy window
- [ ] Compliance logs: audit collection active for private customers (security)

QUICK RISK SCORECARD (my rubric = Low/Med/High + short mitigation):
- Feature flag misconfig (Med) -> Preflight toggle test + owner: Victor -> mitigation: hold toggle if anomaly
- Slow KV cache warmup (Med) -> Pre-populate top-10 keys, owner: Rohit -> mitigation: extend canary window
- Model bundle size mismatch on serving nodes (High) -> owner: Kai -> mitigation: fallback to prior stable bundle + immediate traffic swap
- Telemetry alert flapping (Low) -> owner: Aria -> mitigation: suppress noisy alerts for 10m post-deploy then re-enable

GO / NO-GO DECISION CRITERIA (what I will ask in meeting):
- Are all blocking JIRAs resolved or have mitigations? (Required)
- Are the health checks green for 2 consecutive runs in staging? (Preferred)
- Is rollback validated end-to-end in staging? (Required)
- Is on-call coverage confirmed for the 2-hour window after deploy? (Required)
If any Required item is NO -> NO-GO.

DEPLOY WINDOW & ROLLBACK:
- Target window: Thu 11:00 - 11:30 PST.
- Rollback trigger: >3% error rate sustained for 3 minutes OR latency p50 > 2x baseline for 5 minutes.
- Rollback owner: Kai (infra lead) executes traffic shift; Elena coordinates communications.
- Rollback validation: smoke check endpoints, sample chat generation, embedding calls.

COMMUNICATIONS:
- Pre-deploy Slack: #release-liftoff (Victor to post 15m prior).
- Post-deploy: quick status update pinned in thread and a short summary in the release doc.
- Customer-impact comms: Trigger customer success only if rollback occurs or >5% of requests affected.

EMERGENCY CONTACTS (in order):
1) Kai Nguyen (infra) - pager: +1-555-1023
2) Aria Singh (SRE) - pager: +1-555-1102
3) Elena Park (Release Manager) - mobile: +1-555-1166
4) Victor Chen (PM) - slack DM

OPEN QUESTIONS I WANT ADDRESSED IN THE MEETING:
- Does the canary have realistic traffic shape? (console routing uses spike generator but not long-tail yet)
- Any outstanding infra churn expected during the deploy window?
- Is the observability retention policy sufficient to check post-deploy traces (need 48h recommended)?

POST-MEETING FOLLOW-UPS (my rapid capture format):
- [ ] Action A: Flip canary flag at T+00:10 if no anomalies (owner: Rohit, due: 2026-03-12 11:10 PST)
- [ ] Action B: Add migration pre-check to runbook with script link (owner: Sam, due: 2026-03-12 EOD) -> jira: RELEASE-1222
- [ ] Action C: Run model-bundle checksum across nodes and post results to thread (owner: Kai, due: 2026-03-12 10:45 PST)
- [ ] Action D: Create a short postmortem template for any rollback events and add to release doc (owner: Elena, due: 2026-03-13)
- [ ] Action E: Product to confirm feature flag matrix and safe-fallback default (owner: Victor, due: 2026-03-12 10:30 PST)

NOTES I WANT TO SAY (verbatim prompts for meeting):
- "If any Required item is unresolved, we stop. No partial approvals."
- "Kai, if you see bundle mismatch, call the rollback immediately; do not wait for PM approval."
- "Keep customer-facing messaging high-level unless we have an RCA."

Rough estimate of time I will spend on this doc pre-meeting: 12-18 mins. Post-meeting capture goal: capture actions within 5 minutes of meeting end and push updates to Confluence + Slack thread.

Personal reflection: I’m holding a lower risk tolerance on model bundle changes after last month’s incident; want explicit bundle checksum verification added as a gate. Also prioritizing clear ownership for toggles (owner pinned in the action item).

END (save to release doc after meeting and move actionable items into JIRA).
